//: This root-level package.json does NOT manage the client or server packages.
Its sole purpose is to provide convenience scripts that run BOTH the client
and server at the same time using the 'concurrently' package.
You still need to run 'npm install' inside /client and /server separately.
• concurrently: Lets you run multiple npm scripts at the same time.
name: study-planner

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
